description: Create multiple-choice quizzes from a topic or your lesson notes. Review 1–20 questions with 2–4 choices and one correct answer per question, simplify them, or translate them. Open the preview in Funlearny, sign in, and choose Save to keep it as a private draft. Designed for teachers and adult learning-content creators. Quizzes are never published automatically.

defaultPrompt: Create a 5-question addition quiz for second grade, with 3 choices per question.
